# OrderedList

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ListElementBase`.

### `AddItem`

```csharp
void AddItem(string item)
```

Adds a text item to this list

Example:

```csharp
var list = new OrderedList { NumberFormat = NumberFormat.LowerRoman }; list.AddItem("Preliminaries"); list.AddItem("Main text");
```
